bullets.title: Fed Sept 17 hike risk rising on hawkish August jobs data
bullets.body: August's E/Pop rebound reversed the dovish July signal that had been concentrated in older workers, reinforcing FOMC's view of a strong labor market. Rate hike probability climbs materially if Core PCE tracks at 15 bps or above; Wednesday import prices and Friday CPI are the key pre-meeting data points.

bullets.title: US midterm policy implications likely underpriced by markets
bullets.body: Jefferies warns a split Congress outcome — the consensus base case — shifts policy action toward Executive Orders, Congressional Oversight, and fiscal brinkmanship rather than major legislation, with meaningful implications for investor positioning into 2027-28.

bullets.title: Euro area consumption resilient in H1 but H2 payback risk flagged
bullets.body: JPMorgan reports Euro area private consumption grew 0.9% annualized in H1 2026, with 2Q accelerating to 1.6% ar; real income declines were far milder than feared (-0.3% ar vs. -2.2% forecast in 2Q). Durables surged 5.6% ar partly on German EV incentives, creating payback risk into H2, and JPMorgan models only 1.25% ar pace in 3Q as real incomes continue modest declines.

bullets.title: OpenAI/Microsoft face new copyright suit over AI training data
bullets.body: The Seattle Times and Newsday filed a copyright infringement lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft, alleging their journalism was used to train AI models without permission — adding to the growing litigation overhang on large-scale AI training practices.

bullets.title: US hotel RevPAR softening; international demand holding
bullets.body: Hedgeye data shows RevPAR breadth weakening across Top 25 US markets, while international RevPAR (Europe, Asia) remains strong. Macau GGR came in -1% YoY, well below initial growth expectations, with 2H forecast cut to ~low-single-digit growth vs. prior estimates.
